title: link_ctx.h stale QUARANTINED-PENDING-UPSTREAM-MIGRATION paragraph contradicts the implemented upstream AddrForKey
description: Flagged independently by kimi-k3 in codereview passes 1 and 3 of b7z9.121.2. lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link_ctx.h:452-457 doc comment on lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 first states the SHA-512 native profile 'is gone' (correct: identity_addr.c implements upstream AddrForKey, verified 12/12 against test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json), then immediately appends 'QUARANTINED-PENDING-UPSTREAM-MIGRATION: this profile and its vectors are the rejected SHA-512 native profile... tracked by bead project-LICHEN-worker6-q6ko' - self-contradictory stale text. The same stale pattern exists in lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid's comment in identity_addr.c (that one is correct: the IID derivation is a different function and genuinely remains SHA-512-based pending q6ko). Fix: remove/reword only the quarantine paragraph on the ygg-addr-from-ed25519 block; leave lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid's intact. P3 doc rot. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.121.2.
close_reason: Removed the self-contradictory quarantine paragraph from link_ctx.h:452-457 (upstream AddrForKey helper block) per the bead; kept the legitimate one on lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid (SHA-512 IID). Consolidated single delegated review pass (doc-only, 4 deleted comment lines; correctness/security/edge all checked by kimi-k3, PASS): no dangling refs; also removed a pointer to the vanished q6ko bead (rul5). typos-clean by inspection (no code changed).
